### Performance Issues

#### Feature is Slow or Unresponsive

**Possible Causes:**
- Slow internet connection
- Device performance issues
- High server load

**Solutions:**

1. **Check your internet connection:**
   - Test speed at [speedtest.net](https://speedtest.net)
   - Minimum required: 5 Mbps download

2. **Restart the app:**
   - Close and reopen Bayit+
   - Clear app cache (if available)

3. **Update the app:**
   - Check App Store / Play Store for updates
   - Install latest version

4. **Contact support:**
   - If issue persists, contact [support@bayitplus.com](mailto:support@bayitplus.com)
